title: MediEval: A Unified Medical Benchmark for Patient-Contextual and Knowledge-Grounded Reasoning in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of model failure modes to identify if strong surface cues (e.g., lexical overlap of medical terms) bias models toward conceptual matching rather than strict contextual grounding in the patient record.

Calculation of macro-averaged Precision, Recall, and per-quadrant F1 scores to expose systematic model tendencies, such as an intrinsic bias to overpredict that a statement is 'supported' by the evidence.
